fields.label: Name
fields.description: What to call this credential here — “Hostinger (main account)”. Only a label; the provider is chosen below.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Which API this token is for. Each expects a different kind of credential and calls it a different thing, which is why the form names it as that provider names it.

fields.label: Use by default
fields.description: Pre-selected when a domain needs pointing. Setting it here clears it everywhere else — there is only one default.

fields.label: Last Verified
fields.description: When the credential was last known to work. A token that has been revoked keeps working here until something asks the provider, so this is the age of the last real answer.

fields.label: Last Error
fields.description: Why the last check failed, in the provider's own words where they were useful.

fields.label: Token
fields.description: Hostinger: an API token from hPanel → API. GoDaddy: a v3 Personal Access Token from developer.godaddy.com with the domains.domain:read and domains.dns:update scopes — NOT the older key and secret, which is deprecated and does not work. Stored encrypted and never sent back to the browser.

fields.label: Domains
fields.description: Filled in by verifying the credential. What this token can actually write to, which is not always what somebody expects it to be.
